title: Joshua Bible Quiz - Chapter 20
description: Ten questions on Joshua 20: the cities of refuge for anyone who killed a person unintentionally.

questions.text: Through whom had Yahweh earlier spoken about the cities of refuge?
questions.explanation: In Joshua 20:2 Yahweh speaks of the cities of refuge "of which I spoke to you by Moses."

questions.text: Who was allowed to flee to a city of refuge?
questions.explanation: Joshua 20:3 says the cities were for the man slayer who kills any person accidentally or unintentionally.

answers.text: Someone who killed a person accidentally
A person who owed a debt

questions.text: From whom were the cities of refuge meant to protect the man slayer?
questions.explanation: Joshua 20:3 says the cities would be a refuge from the avenger of blood.

questions.text: Where was the man slayer to stand when he arrived at the city?
questions.explanation: Joshua 20:4 says he was to stand at the entrance of the gate of the city.

answers.text: On top of the city wall
At the entrance of the gate
In the middle of the marketplace

questions.text: To whom was the man slayer to declare his case?
questions.explanation: Joshua 20:4 says he was to declare his case in the ears of the elders of that city.

questions.text: Until whose death was the man slayer to dwell in the city of refuge?
questions.explanation: Joshua 20:6 says he was to dwell there until the death of the high priest of those days.

questions.text: Kiriath Arba, one of the cities of refuge, was also called what?
questions.explanation: Joshua 20:7 names Kiriath Arba, also called Hebron, in the hill country of Judah.

questions.text: In whose hill country was Shechem, which was set apart as a city of refuge?
questions.explanation: Joshua 20:7 says they set apart Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim.

questions.text: Out of which tribe was Ramoth in Gilead assigned?
questions.explanation: Joshua 20:8 says Ramoth in Gilead was assigned out of the tribe of Gad.

questions.text: Besides the children of Israel, who else could flee to these cities?
questions.explanation: Joshua 20:9 says the cities were also for the alien who lives among them.

answers.text: The alien who lives among them
